name: Khoj
description: Khoj is a self-hostable AI second brain. It answers questions from your notes and documents (Markdown, Obsidian, Org-Mode, PDF and more) with semantic search and chat, using any online or self-hosted OpenAI-compatible model backend such as Ollama. Clients include the web app and official Obsidian and Emacs plugins.

notes.text: The server runs in anonymous mode for single-user LAN use. Admin panel credentials (KHOJ_ADMIN_EMAIL / KHOJ_ADMIN_PASSWORD) are stored in /opt/khoj/.env.

Connect a chat model backend after installation via the admin panel at /server/admin: add an 'AI Model API' with your OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. Ollama at http://<host>:11434/v1/), then restart the khoj service to sync its models. Auto-configuration via OPENAI_BASE_URL in /opt/khoj/.env only applies on the very first service start. See https://docs.khoj.dev/advanced/ollama.
KHOJ_DOMAIN in /opt/khoj/.env is set to the container IP at install time. If the container IP changes, update it and restart the service to avoid CSRF/login errors.
The server uses unencrypted HTTP with anonymous mode enabled. Restrict access to a trusted local network or place a VPN or HTTPS reverse proxy in front of it before exposing it publicly.
Embedding models (a few hundred MB) are downloaded from Hugging Face on first start, so the first indexing run can take a while.
